items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Jim Robinson and asks if the interviewee heard him play. The interviewee's only response is 'Yeah.' There is no evidence of personal interaction, collaboration, or mentorship, only that the interviewee was aware of him and likely heard him perform.

ctx.x: Oh, yeh, played beautiful fiddle. He had a nice little group on Bourbon Street and I had occasion to sit in quite a few times. I worked one night with them. A. J. Piron, I shall never forget him, as well as down the street was Fats Pichon, famous boggie-woggie piano player and also -- I can't think of it right now.
